questions.title: Walking club - Part 1

metadata.scenario: When and where do you like to walk?

questions.stem: Respond to the messages in the group.

questions.prompt: I usually go for a walk. Do you like to walk or not?
questions.sample_answer: I love walking, and it’s part of my daily routine. I often walk to work, which is a great way to stay fit and clear my mind before starting the day.

questions.prompt: I like to walk, but when it rains, I get wet. Tell me about a time you had a bad experience while walking.
questions.sample_answer: Last year, I went on a long solo walk around Hoan Kiem Lake, which took almost two hours. When I got home, my legs were sore. While it was a memorable experience, I don’t think I’ll do it again unless I have a friend to join me.

questions.prompt: Walking is the best form of exercise. What do you think when many people walk and know if it is good for your health?
questions.sample_answer: I believe walking is the best form of exercise. Walking daily helps you stay fit and is an excellent way to relieve stress after a long day. It’s also completely free. It's accessible to everyone and doesn't require special equipment
